title: Why a Hyperliquid Treasury Firm Wants to Become a US Futures Broker
summary: Hyperliquid Strategies has applied to become a U.S. futures commission merchant, a move that could let Americans trade perpetual futures on permissioned Hyperliquid markets, pending regulatory approval.

title: Hyperliquid Strategies seeks futures registration for perps
summary: The HYPE treasury company spent $785 million on tokens during the quarter and wants to bring Hyperliquid-based perpetual futures to the US.

title: Hyperliquid treasury firm seeking U.S. regulatory nod as a domestic futures platform
summary: The company said it's trying to establish a U.S. "futures commission merchant" with full compliance for activity with U.S. clients, though the timing is uncertain.

title: Hyperliquid Strategies files to become CFTC-registered FCM, posts $13.3 million in quaterly revenue
summary: Hyperliquid Strategies posted $13.3M in revenue and $620.6M net income, and filed with the CFTC to become an FCM for U.S. HIP-3 perp markets.
